description: This file contains utility functions and classes for the 'behave' BDD testing framework, including parsers, feature collection, step module loading, and runtime reset functions.

classes.name: FileLocationParser
classes.description: Parses text into FileLocation objects, supporting filename and optional line number.

classes.name: FeatureLineDatabase
classes.description: Supports select-by-location mechanism within feature files, storing line numbers for entities.

classes.name: FeatureScenarioLocationCollector
classes.description: Collects FileLocation objects for scenarios in a feature, used to select specific scenarios to run.

classes.name: FeatureScenarioLocationCollector1
classes.description: Subclass with specific scenario line selection logic.

classes.name: FeatureScenarioLocationCollector2
classes.description: Subclass that uses line database for scenario selection.

classes.name: FeatureListParser
classes.description: Parses feature list files containing filenames, locations, and wildcards.

classes.name: PathManager
classes.description: Context manager to temporarily modify sys.path within a scope.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a list of feature files or locations into feature objects.

methods.name: parse_file
methods.description: Reads a feature list file and parses contained feature locations.

methods.name: collect_feature_locations
methods.description: Collects feature file locations from command line paths, directories, or list files.

methods.name: exec_file
methods.description: Executes a Python script file, updating globals and locals.

methods.name: load_step_modules
methods.description: Loads step definition modules from specified directories.

methods.name: make_undefined_step_snippet
methods.description: Creates a code snippet for an undefined step.

methods.name: make_undefined_step_snippets
methods.description: Generates snippets for multiple undefined steps, removing duplicates.

methods.name: print_undefined_step_snippets
methods.description: Prints snippets for undefined steps to a stream.

methods.name: reset_runtime
methods.description: Resets the runtime environment to initial state.
